FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Bridal Bliss Boutique, we specialize in providing an exceptional selection of bridal gowns, veils, and accessories tailored to meet the diverse needs of our clients. Our operations focus on personalized service, offering private consultations and fittings in our welcoming showroom, ensuring that each bride experiences a memorable journey as she prepares for her special day. Our dedicated team is composed of experienced staff who are trained in customer service and product knowledge, allowing us to effectively assist clients in choosing the perfect attire. We maintain strong relationships with trusted suppliers to ensure the quality and timely delivery of our inventory. Additionally, we continuously review our operational practices and inventory management systems to address any issues of turnover and maintain optimal cash flow. This commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction defines our core operations and positions us as a preferred bridal shop in the community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, we experienced water damage due to a burst pipe, resulting in $1,500 in inventory loss and $1,000 in repair costs. This claim has been settled and is currently marked as complete.

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and patrol services during business hours.
